translation: …So? You were saying?
I was saying…?
Don't play dumb—why did you stop me earlier?
You didn't finish telling me.
Ah! So I did—do pardon my rudeness.
I was merely wondering…

Is Miss Suzumiya actually the type to be
easily persuaded by others?
…What do you mean?

Although we've only known each other for a
bit, I've been analyzing her in my own way.

If I had to say, she may be the type that
likes to solve everything by herself.
Well, that might be true.

If that's so, wouldn't imposing our own concl-
usions on her have the opposite effect?

Observing her own evidence, assembling her
deductions, and being led to her conclusions…

Only by doing so herself would Miss Suzumiya
be fully convinced, don't you think?

Don't be so long-winded. In short, she'll reject
any opinions that aren't her own, huh?

I don't have the nerve to assert it so
confidently, I'm afraid.
After all—I'm quite the timid person.

You have quite the nerve to say something
you know isn't true…

Ummm… About that, couldn't the reverse also
happen?

Asahina jumped in unexpectedly. The reverse?
What would that mean?

Umm—like if we were to guide her to a
conclusion that would convince her, maybe…
I was just considering the same thing.

As long as she's convinced, that's all that
matters, even if—for example—we trick her.

…Dangle the glimmering carrot of evidence in
front of her face huh?
I suppose that's also one method to consider.
…One method to consider…
Nagato—what do you think?
Surely you at least have an opinion?

Haruhi Suzumiya's decision is the conclusion.
The process does not matter.
…Therefore, guidance is effective.

In other words—Nagato has the same view
as Koizumi and Asahina.

Arranging clues at every turn in order to
guide Miss Suzumiya's deduction…

Most likely, it will require quite a bit of team
play, wouldn't you say?

I agree. We can't accomplish much on our own.
Cooperation is paramount.

Alright, so if we take that line of action…
what should we start with?
Information sharing is a maximum priority.

It is essential that all members know the
counter-measure.

That's right. Let's share any "clues” we
found while investigating.

Something that I don't know, someone else
might know.

We quickly exchanged all the information we
had with each other…
About Haruhi
